dialog.english:
scape looks different, so
I don't know how to find the
Village of Beginnings...
dialog.translation:
...el paisaje es distinto, así
que no sé cómo encontrar
la Ciudad de los Bebés...

dialog.english:
I'm tired! I can't take another
step...
dialog.translation:
Cansada! No puedo dar
un paso más...

dialog.english: Mimi is hungry, ribbit!

Hang in there, tama! I'll be back
with some food, tama!
dialog.translation:
Aguanta, tama! Voy a por
comida, tama!

dialog.english: Ah! No, no, I didn't mean to...
dialog.translation:
Ah! No, no quería decir
eso...

dialog.english: We know, ribbit!

But we'd like to do something
useful, tama! So wait for us,
tama!
dialog.translation:
Pero queremos ser útiles,
tama! Esperadnos, tama!

dialog.english: I'll go with you, too!

Aren't they being a little *too*
nice to me?
dialog.translation:
No os parece que se
pasan DEMASIADO conmigo?

dialog.english: That's because they like you.
Sorry for the wait, ribbit!

Wow! You even found some cola! Aw,
but it's not cold...
dialog.translation:
Vaya! Hasta encontrasteis
cola! Pero no está fría...

dialog.english:
Let me borrow it. I'll chill it up
for you.
Burn, burn, burn! And it's cooked.
dialog.translation:
Arde, arde, arde! Y ya
está hecho.

dialog.english: Not bad! You're pretty useful!
dialog.translation:
No está mal! Sirves para
algo!

dialog.english: *zzzzzzzzzz*

You know, Joe... you don't have to
be a doctor if you don't want to.
dialog.translation:
Sabes, Joe... no tienes
que ser médico si no
quieres.

dialog.english: But Dad said...

That's what Dad wants. But you
need to find your own path for
yourself.
dialog.translation:
Eso es lo que él quiere.
Pero debes buscar tu
propio camino.

dialog.english: It was a dream...
Ogremon?
Yeah?
It's my turn.
Really? Okay, take it.

Find my own path... Is that what
you did, Matt?
dialog.translation:
Buscar mi propio
camino... Eso hiciste tú,
Matt?

dialog.english: This is the Village of Beginnings.
dialog.translation:
Esta es la Aldea del
Comienzo.

dialog.english: So cruel...
What's wrong, Joe?
I just...
Yeah, that's it!
Hey, Joe!

Was that... the sound of a
harmonica?
Let's go check it out!

What?! It was you... I was so sure
it was...
dialog.translation:
Qué?! Eras tú... Estaba
seguro de que era...

dialog.english:
Now that the Village of Beginnings
is like this, there's nothing left
for me to do...
dialog.translation:
Ahora que la Aldea del
Comienzo está así, ya no
tengo nada que hacer...

dialog.english:
By the way, how are T.K and
Patamon doing?
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, cómo están
T.K. y Patamon?

dialog.english: Oh! They're doing fine.

We're not really traveling
together, though.
dialog.translation:
Aunque la verdad, no
viajamos juntos.

dialog.english: I see... Good to hear!
Hey, why don't you come with us?
dialog.translation:
Por qué no vienes con
nosotros?

dialog.english: Huh?

The village won't go back to
normal until we defeat the Dark
Masters.
dialog.translation:
La aldea no será normal
hasta que venzamos a
los Amos Oscuros.

dialog.english:
We're looking for allies to help
us!

Defeat the Dark Masters? Man, you
guys think big!
dialog.translation:
Vencer a los Amos Oscuros?
Vaya, qué ambiciosos!

dialog.english:
We're not just thinking about it!
The fight's already started!
dialog.translation:
No es solo un plan! La
lucha ya ha empezado!

dialog.english:
T.K and Patamon are fighting,
too!
dialog.translation:
T.K. y Patamon también
están luchando!

dialog.english:
Well, I guess I can't just let
Patamon one-up me!
dialog.translation:
Bueno, no puedo dejar que
Patamon me haga sombra!

dialog.english:
I'll come with you, then! You guys
won't be able to do anything by
yourselves, anyway.
dialog.translation:
Entonces voy con
vosotros! Solos no haríais
nada de nada.

dialog.english: Now *what* did ya just say?!

By the way, about that
harmonica...
About that harmonica...

Oh, this? Someone dropped it on
the shore. I found it there.
dialog.translation:
Esto? Alguien lo dejó
caer en la orilla. Lo
encontré allí.

dialog.english:
Dropped? Let me see it for a
second...
Yep, it's Matt's.
dialog.translation:
Caer? Déjame verla un
segundo...
Sí, es de Matt.

dialog.english: it's Matt's.

Really? Then he must be around
here! But...
dialog.translation:
En serio? Entonces debe
estar cerca! Pero...

dialog.english:
Now that you mention it, I saw a
swan boat going off into the
sea...
dialog.translation:
Ahora que lo dices, vi
una barca cisne yéndose
hacia el mar...

dialog.english:
I thought it was the Nightmare
Soldiers doing something weird
again.
dialog.translation:
Pensé que eran los
Soldados de la Pesadilla
haciendo de las suyas.

dialog.english: A swan boat?

No doubt about it, it's Matt.
Listen, Mimi...
dialog.translation:
No hay duda, es Matt.
Escucha, Mimi...

dialog.english:
Now that we've gotten some more
allies, Gomamon and I don't need
to be here anymore, right?
dialog.translation:
Ahora que ya tenemos más
aliados, Gomamon y yo ya
no hacemos falta, no?

dialog.english:
Huh? What do you mean? Are you
going somewhere, Joe?
dialog.translation:
Eh? Qué quieres decir? Te
vas a algún sitio, Joe?

dialog.english: I'm going after Matt.

But then we should all go
together...

No, Gomamon and I will go by
ourselves.
dialog.translation:
No, Gomamon y yo iremos
solos.

dialog.english: Why?
We have to follow our own paths.
dialog.translation:
Cada uno sigue su propio
camino.

dialog.english:
You're taking the path of finding
allies, Mimi. Tai's group is 
taking the path of fighting.
dialog.translation:
Tú sigues el camino de
los aliados, Mimi. El de
Tai es el de la lucha.

dialog.english:
No, no, I'm not going to let
Tai fight by himself. I want to
fight, too!
dialog.translation:
No, no voy a dejar que
Tai luche solo. Yo
también quiero luchar!

dialog.english:
And I thought, "But I'm not
strong, I'm only getting in the
way..."
dialog.translation:
Y pensé, "no soy fuerte,
solo estorbo..."

dialog.english: Joe...

But I'm pretty sure there's
something that only I can do!
dialog.translation:
Pero seguro que hay algo
que solo yo puedo hacer!

dialog.english:
I think that's the kind of thing
Matt was thinking, too. So I'm
gonna go after him!
dialog.translation:
Creo que eso pensaba Matt
también. Así que voy a
buscarlo!

dialog.english: Joe...

Let 'im go. He's tougher than he
looks!
dialog.translation:
Déjale. Es más fuerte de
lo que parece!

dialog.english:
Is it okay for me to come to a
conclusion, just like that?
dialog.translation:
Está bien decidir así,
sin más?

dialog.english: Of course it is!
Thanks, Gomamon!

Matt, this cave creeps me out.
Let's find a way out of here!
dialog.translation:
Matt, esta cueva me da
mal rollo. Busquemos una
salida!

dialog.english: Yeah, you're right...

I've always been saying that
T.K needs me, but the truth is 
that I'm the one who needed him.
dialog.translation:
Siempre digo que T.K. me
necesita, pero la verdad
es que yo le necesitaba.

dialog.english: Huh?

If I got him to depend on me, then
I'd have my life's purpose...
dialog.translation:
Si lograba que dependiera
de mí, tendría un
propósito...

dialog.english:
That's why I always got mad at
Tai. I felt like he was taking
him away from me...
dialog.translation:
Por eso me enfadaba con
Tai. Sentía que me lo
quitaba...

dialog.english: What's wrong? Matt...

It's over for me. I can't just go
back to being their friend.
dialog.translation:
Se acabó para mí. Ya no
puedo volver a ser su
amigo, sin más.

dialog.english:
Don't say that! All eight of us
have to work together if we wanna
save the world!
dialog.translation:
No digas eso! Los ocho
tenemos que unirnos para
salvar el mundo!

dialog.english:
They don't need me. Nothing would
change if I weren't there...
dialog.translation:
No me necesitan. Nada
cambiaría si yo no
estuviera...

dialog.english: Matt...
Ow! The heck was that?!

There's only one of you in this
world, Matt!
dialog.translation:
Solo hay un Matt en este
mundo!

dialog.english:
What am *I* supposed to do if
you're not here?
dialog.translation:
Qué se supone que haga YO
si tú no estás?

dialog.english:
I spent all this time in this
world, waiting for you!
dialog.translation:
Pasé todo este tiempo
aquí, esperándote!

dialog.english: Gabumon...

Do you really want to be alone?
Because if you really, truly do,
I'll leave.
dialog.translation:
De verdad quieres estar
solo? Porque si es así,
me iré.

dialog.english:
No, I don't want to be alone... I
lied.
dialog.translation:
No, no quiero estar
solo... Mentí.

dialog.english:
I was just trying to feel cool...
but the truth is... I'm really
lonely.
dialog.translation:
Solo quería parecer
guay... pero la verdad es
que estoy muy solo.

dialog.english: Matt...

I always thought, "I shouldn't
cry"... But I really, really want
to!
dialog.translation:
Siempre pensé, "no debo
llorar"... Pero de verdad
quiero hacerlo!

dialog.english: I hate being alone...

I'm here, right? I'm relying on
you...
dialog.translation:
Estoy aquí, no? Confío
en ti...

dialog.english:
So you can rely on me, and we'll
be able to do more together!
dialog.translation:
Así que puedes confiar
en mí, y podremos hacer
más juntos!

dialog.english:
Gabumon... you're right, you're
here with me.
dialog.translation:
Gabumon... tienes razón,
estás aquí conmigo.

dialog.english: I'm not alone...
Matt...

I've got friends... I've got
T.K, and my mom and dad...
dialog.translation:
Tengo amigos... Tengo a
T.K., y a mis padres...

dialog.english: Did the cave just... disappear?
Matt, look!
What's that?

That thing was floating around
you. Didn't you notice?
dialog.translation:
Esa cosa flotaba a tu
alrededor. No lo notaste?

dialog.english:
It was trying to get inside your
heart.

No, that's not it... the darkness
in my lonely heart was attracting
it.
dialog.translation:
No, no es eso... la
oscuridad de mi corazón
solitario la atraía.

dialog.english: But it's different now!
That's right!

It's only gonna get tougher from
here on out, so I'm going to have
to rely on you quite a bit.
dialog.translation:
Esto se pondrá más duro,
así que voy a tener que
confiar mucho en ti.

dialog.english: No problem!

I'm not gonna just sit around and
complain anymore.
dialog.translation:
Ya no voy a quedarme
quejándome sin más.

dialog.english:
I don't mind if you do, as long as
I'm the only one you do it to!
dialog.translation:
No me importa si te
quejas, mientras sea
solo conmigo!

dialog.english:
Fine! Then I'll save my
complaints, just for you!
dialog.translation:
Vale! Pues guardaré mis
quejas solo para ti!

dialog.english: Haha!
Haha!
Heeeeeeey! Matt!
Joe!
*pant* *pant* *pant*

See? Did you see that? Look who
found him!
dialog.translation:
Lo ves? Mira quién le
encontró!

dialog.english:
Hey, I never said you *weren't*
gonna!
dialog.translation:
Oye, nunca dije que NO
fueras a poder!

dialog.english: What's wrong?

I just wanted to tell you that you
should follow your own path, and
have faith in it...
dialog.translation:
Solo quería decirte que
sigas tu propio camino, y
que confíes en él...

dialog.english: I see.
Oh, and here!
Oh, and here!
It's your harmonica, right?
It's your harmonica, right?
Oh! Thank you!
Gabumon! Are you ready?
Yeah!
Well done, Gabumon!
Great job, Gomamon!
So what do we do now?
Well... uh...
Sora! Sora...!
That voice...
Could it be... T.K?
Let's go!
Yeah!
We can't find Matt at all...

(At this rate, Tai and the
others are going to...)
dialog.translation:
(A este paso, Tai y los
demás van a...)

dialog.english:
(No, I have to find them... I
promised I would... I'll find
them, no matter what...)
dialog.translation:
(No, tengo que
encontrarlos... Lo
prometí... Los encontraré.)

dialog.english:
Sora! There's something black on
your feet!
dialog.translation:
Sora, tienes algo negro
en los pies!

dialog.english: Huh?
Aaaaaaaaah!
Sora!
Sora! Sora...!
T.K!

Ah! Matt! Where were you? I was
so worried...
dialog.translation:
Matt! Dónde estabas?
Estaba tan preocupado...

dialog.english:
I'm really sorry. I won't leave
you from now on. I promise.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento mucho. No te
voy a dejar más. Te lo
prometo.

dialog.english: Huh? Matt, you've changed...

More importantly, what happened
here?
dialog.translation:
Más importante, qué ha
pasado aquí?

dialog.english: Sora fell into that cave!
Sora?

It's a cave like the one we were
in before...
dialog.translation:
Es una cueva como en la
que estuvimos antes...

dialog.english: What cave?
Let's go help her!
Sora! What's wrong? Hey, Sora!
Sora!
Guys...

Sora! What's wrong? Come on, get
up...
...! She's heavy!
What the...?
She's saying something...
I have to find Mimi...

And Joe, and Matt... if I can't
help Tai, our world's done
for...
dialog.translation:
Y a Joe, y a Matt... si no
puedo ayudar a Tai, nuestro
mundo se acaba...

dialog.english:
She's being saying that for a
while now.

I have to get myself together... I
have to help Tai... Or else the
world will end...
dialog.translation:
Tengo que centrarme...
Tengo que ayudar a Tai...
O el mundo se acabará...

dialog.english:
Sora, you've got a real sense of
responsibility...
dialog.translation:
Sora, tienes mucho
sentido de la
responsabilidad...

dialog.english:
Sora, you have to stop thinking
like that! This cave comes from 
the darkness inside your heart!
dialog.translation:
Sora, deja de pensar así!
Esta cueva viene de la
oscuridad de tu corazón!

dialog.english: Thinking... like this...?

We're not obligated to do
anything!
dialog.translation:
No estamos obligados a
hacer nada!

dialog.english:
You don't have to do anything if
you don't want to! We came this
far because we did!
dialog.translation:
No tienes que hacer nada
si no quieres! Llegamos
hasta aquí porque quisimos!

dialog.english:
If I don't want to... No, I have
to...
dialog.translation:
Si no quiero... No,
tengo que...

dialog.english:
Sora, I know that things really
don't look good for us right
now...
dialog.translation:
Sora, sé que las cosas
no pintan bien ahora
mismo...

dialog.english:
But we've come this far because we
can get past it!
dialog.translation:
Pero llegamos hasta aquí
porque podemos con esto!

dialog.english: Can we... do it?
Doesn't that give you courage?

We've come this far... because we
can get past it!
dialog.translation:
Hemos llegado hasta
aquí... porque podemos
con esto!

dialog.english: We can do it! That's right!
Sora!
Piyomon...

I'm glad to see you back to
normal, Sora!
dialog.translation:
Me alegro de verte bien
de nuevo, Sora!

dialog.english: Guys, Tai's waiting for us!
Yeah!
Let's go meet up with Tai!
Yeah!
All right, it's time to go!
